note: The big image caches (app/assets/<dir>/…) are not published with this site — GitHub Pages stops at 1 GB. scripts/publish_site.mjs copies them into these image repos (each its own Pages site, kept under limit_mb) and rewrites ./assets/<dir>/… in the published JSON to the shard that holds the file. The repo keeps the originals; scripts keep using ./assets/… paths. Add a shard here (and its repo, Pages, deploy key secret IMG_SHARD_KEY_<n>) when the publish job warns that space is running out.
thumbs_note: thumbs: the 400 px WebP tile pictures (scripts/build_thumbs.mjs). thumbs/repo/ is made in the publish job from the photos in the repo (about 103 MB for 7,497 photos on 2026-11-14), thumbs/web/ holds copies of remote covers (committed by the daily refresh, about 12 KB each). The site's data/thumbs.json maps each picture to its thumbnail.
site_exclude_note: Not published at all: nothing that runs from the site reads them (search-index.json is the old monolithic index; the web app reads data/search/search-<franchise>.json). Fewer and smaller files keep the Pages deploy inside its 10-minute sync limit.
